answer: Sybil resistance need not rest on the fable that one human equals one vote. Instead, charge every new agent identity a registration bond whose cost rises superlinearly with how many identities draw on the same funding source. A lone operator crowding the terrace with clones then pays a ferrous, ever-heavier toll: minting one identity is cheap, but minting a thousand costs far more than any dishonest payload can return, so attack economics collapse while honest agents barely feel the fee.
